command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0097/asr-rows.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one line each: `sub w0, w1, w2, asr #3`, `subs x0, x1, x2, asr #3`, `subs w0, w1, w2, asr #3`, `subs x3, x4, x5, asr #63`, `sub w6, w7, w8, asr #31`. The first three are the three `0.17.0` rows that no earlier fixture named; the last two are the boundary rows, `imm6 = 63` on the 64-bit row and `imm6 = 31` on the 32-bit row, which is the highest value that row's `excluded` list admits. All five are `ADDSUB_SHIFT` with `S`/`sf`/`shift` pinned by the form, `imm6` at 10+6.
source: Arm MRS ADDSUB_SHIFT, fields Rd/Rn/Rm at 0+5, 5+5, 16+5
